record.paper_title: Open Problems in Affine Differential Geometry and Related Topics
record.original_question: Let (M, g) be an n-dimensional Riemannian manifold equipped with two affine connections ∇ and ∇* that are dual to each other with respect to g, so that {M, g, ∇, ∇*} is a dually flat space, meaning that both ∇ and ∇* are flat affine connections. What conditions are necessary and sufficient for this dually flat space to be realizable as an n-dimensional submanifold of an m-dimensional dually flat manifold {M̃, g̃, ∇̃, ∇̃*} with m > n? If realization in a finite-dimensional ambient dually flat manifold is not always possible, what additional quantity or structure must be imposed in order to make such a realization possible?

evidence.quote: Consider a quadruplet {M, g, ∇, ∇*}, where (M, g) is an n-dimensional Riemannian manifold, ∇ and ∇* are affine connections and mutually dual with respect to g. A quadruplet {M, g, ∇, ∇*} is said to be dually flat space if ∇ and ∇* are flat affine connections (cf. [4]). What is the condition {M, g, ∇, ∇*} can be realized by an n-dimensional submanifold in m-dimensional (m > n) dually flat manifold {M̃, g̃, ∇̃, ∇̃*}? If it is not true, what quantity should we impose in order to realize the manifold in a finite dimensional manifold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be an $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifold, and let $
abla$ and $
abla^{*}$ be two torsion-free affine connections on $M$ that are mutually dual with respect to $g$, in the sense that for all vector fields $X,Y,Z$ on $M$,
$$X\,g(Y,Z) \;=\; g(
abla_{X}Y,Z) + g(Y,
abla^{*}_{X}Z).$$
The quadruplet $\{M,g,
abla,
abla^{*}\}$ is called a dually flat space if both $
abla$ and $
abla^{*}$ are flat (i.e. their curvature and torsion tensors vanish identically).

A dually flat space $\{M,g,
abla,
abla^{*}\}$ is said to be realized as a submanifold of an $m$-dimensional dually flat manifold $\{\widetilde{M},\widetilde{g},\widetilde{
abla},\widetilde{
abla}^{*}\}$ (with $m>n$) if there exists an immersion $\iota:M\hookrightarrow\widetilde{M}$ such that $g=\iota^{*}\widetilde{g}$ and the induced dual connections from $(\widetilde{
abla},\widetilde{
abla}^{*})$ on $\iota(M)$ coincide with $(
abla,
abla^{*})$.

Problem. 
(a) Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $\{M,g,
abla,
abla^{*}\}$ under which it can be realized as an $n$-dimensional submanifold of some finite-dimensional dually flat manifold $\{\widetilde{M},\widetilde{g},\widetilde{
abla},\widetilde{
abla}^{*}\}$ with $m>n$.
(b) If such a realization in a finite-dimensional ambient dually flat manifold is not always possible, identify an additional intrinsic geometric quantity or structure that must be imposed on $\{M,g,
abla,
abla^{*}\}$ in order to guarantee a realization in a finite-dimensional dually flat manifold.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not return a definitive characterization of when an arbitrary dually flat manifold admits a realization as a submanifold of a finite-dimensional dually flat ambient manifold. While related embedding-type results in information geometry exist (e.g. dually flat embeddings in specific contexts and embeddings of exponential families), no source clearly resolves the general necessary-and-sufficient condition or the obstruction problem posed here, so the status appears unresolved in the public literature.

status_evidence.title: A Dually Flat Embedding of Spacetime
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses dually flat embeddings within information geometry, but in a specialized setting rather than addressing the general realization problem.
status_evidence.claim: Related embedding constructions exist but do not give a general necessary/sufficient criterion.

status_evidence.title: Lagrangian Submanifolds of Symplectic Structures Induced by Divergence Functions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies submanifolds in dually flat / divergence-based structures.
status_evidence.claim: Submanifold theory of dually flat structures is developed in special cases, not as a general characterization.
